$comment: Derived from src/routes.jsx, src/data/contentPages.js, src/data/posts.js and each page component's render order. Section ids are per content block; light/dark variants of the same grid are separate sections because they render differently. Body copy outside the homepage is original placeholder text.

meta.source: impilo.health clone (React + Vite) at /, mirroring https://impilo.health/ plus 2 clone-only pages

categories.SHELL: Chrome mounted by the shared Layout on every route: preloader, header, page transition, footer.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block directly under the header.
categories.FEATURES: Product explanation modules, mostly scroll-driven or illustrated.
categories.PROOF: Trust signals: stats, compliance badges, partner logos, leadership, article teasers.
categories.CONTENT: Substantive body sections of a route.
categories.CONVERSION: Closing calls to action and forms.

shell.preloader.description: First-load overlay: 00→99 counter over the isometric graphic, slides away when loading finishes; never shown again on client-side navigation.
shell.preloader.scope: Mounted in the shared Layout on all 30 routes; only visible on the first page load of a session.

shell.header.description: Non-sticky top bar: logo, 'Our Solutions' and 'Who We Serve' dropdowns, four text links, Request Demo button; hamburger + full-screen dialog menu at ≤500px.
shell.header.scope: Every route; on /request-demo/ the desktop Request Demo button is hidden via a CSS rule.

shell.page-transition.description: Fixed blue overlay with pulse line that slides up over the old page on internal navigation (link click or browser back/forward) and away from the new one.
shell.page-transition.scope: Mounted in the shared Layout on all 30 routes.

shell.footer.description: Fixed footer revealed under the page end: large logo, link columns, mailto/tel contacts, WebGL line field bending around a cursor-following white pill (canvas hidden on mobile).
shell.footer.scope: Every route, via the shared Layout and FooterSpacer.

hero.home.description: Homepage hero: headline with rotating word, line-art illustration with mouse parallax, dashboard mock that zooms from 862 to 1340px wide on scroll with rolling counters.

features.home-focus.description: 'Keep scrolling' marquee pill plus a white panel that grows on scroll; its Request Demo button pins and docks to the top-right through the next section.

features.home-how-it-works.description: Four pinned steps, each with text on the left and an animated SVG illustration in a pinned rounded frame on the right.

proof.compliance-badges.description: White Glove block: intro text plus HIPAA and SOC 2 badges that swap from gray to colour on hover.

proof.partner-logos.description: Four partner logos with an oval hover effect; deliberately non-clickable (no outbound links).

proof.article-carousel.description: Three-article carousel with prev/next arrows and horizontal slide; links point at internal /blog/ posts.

features.home-integrations.description: Three integration cards with floating layered illustrations and an 'Explore Our Integrations' button.

conversion.cta-band.description: Centred closing band: large heading and a primary button; title/label/href are props (homepage defaults).
conversion.cta-band.scope: Homepage plus the 2 clone-only info pages, 3 routes in total.

hero.solutions.description: Solutions overview hero: bobbing line-art devices, four dashboard widget cards and a rolling weight counter; pins while the next section slides over it.

features.solutions-explore.description: Pulse line with a travelling dash, 2×2 illustration boxes with mouse parallax, cart hover bounce and a certification logo row; pins and drifts up 40vh.

features.solutions-support.description: Four support cards that pin at the viewport centre and stack, scaling down and stepping up as the next covers them; thermometer parallax decoration.

features.solutions-platform.description: 3D laptop whose lid opens on scroll, with a 3-slide screen/title/text panel and prev/next arrows (1100ms throttle); stacked panels on mobile.

features.solutions-api.description: API platform block: 2×2 grid of icon feature cards with a link to the internal /developers/ page.

hero.content.description: Blue01 content-page hero: centred title, subtitle, description and a primary button.
hero.content.scope: All 12 solution and use-case detail pages.

proof.hero-stats.description: Row of three short stat claims under the content-page hero.
proof.hero-stats.scope: 9 of the 12 detail pages (absent on digital-health-logistics, clinic-rpm, support-crm).

content.bordered-cards-light.description: Light section with a title and a grid of bordered text cards.

content.bordered-cards-dark.description: Dark section with a title and a grid of bordered text cards (lavender04 border, as measured on the original).

content.icon-cards-light.description: Light section with centred cards each led by a 48px icon; tighter 14/600 type on mobile.
content.icon-cards-light.scope: 4 solution pages: digital-health-logistics, tech-enabled-services, clinic-rpm, support-crm.

content.two-column-dark.description: Dark section with a two-column layout of headline columns and item lists.

content.text-items-light.description: Light section with a grid of title + paragraph items (no card chrome).
content.text-items-light.scope: 4 solution pages: impilo-platform, tech-enabled-services, direct-to-patient, support-crm.

content.text-items-dark.description: Dark section with a grid of title + paragraph items; title forced white (fixes the original's invisible blue-on-blue title on two pages).
content.text-items-dark.scope: 4 solution pages: digital-health-logistics, tech-enabled-services, clinic-rpm, support-crm.

content.problem-solution-light.description: Light use-case section: title + paragraph items followed by an inline button row.
content.problem-solution-light.scope: The 5 use-case pages other than OEMs.

content.capabilities-carousel-dark.description: Dark section with a capabilities carousel: one card at a time, round white arrows and dots, 1s slide-out + fade, no autoplay.

content.outcomes-light.description: Light section with a bulleted outcomes list (fixed 24px indent) followed by an inline button row.

conversion.cta-row-dark.description: Dark closing section: title and a button row (buttons only, no paragraph).
conversion.cta-row-dark.scope: impilo-platform plus all 6 use-case pages, 7 routes in total.

conversion.closing-cta-light.description: Light closing block: title, short paragraph and a single button.

conversion.closing-cta-dark.description: Dark closing block: title, short paragraph and a single button.

hero.about.description: About hero: large headline that fills white line by line as you scroll, pinned on desktop/tablet, with certification logos.

content.about-founded.description: White 'Founded' panel with a horizontal office-photo marquee that speeds up as it scrolls into view.

content.about-anywhere.description: Blue section with a line-fill paragraph and a floating stethoscope illustration.

proof.leadership.description: Leadership grid of 3 cards: headshot, name, role, short bio, unlinked LinkedIn icon; staggered entrance.

conversion.about-careers.description: White careers card with an animated pulse line and a button to the internal /careers/ page.

hero.integrations.description: Integrations hero, pinned at its bottom with content drifting up, plus a half-speed thermometer parallax.

features.integrations-sdk.description: White SDK panel with 4 cards that pin, stack and shrink on scroll; horizontal snap carousel with a nudge hint on touch phones.

features.integrations-devices.description: Dark devices panel: two device-name lists, a laptop whose lid opens on scroll, and a 3-slide crossfade carousel.

conversion.demo-form.description: Request-demo panel with a custom form (text fields, textarea, custom dropdown with conditional fields, in-field REQUIRED/Invalid errors); submission is simulated locally, no network request.

content.legal-document.description: White rounded card with a numbered legal outline (sections with lettered sub-items); placeholder text flagged at the top.

editorial.blog-featured.description: Featured post card: 920-wide cover, date and author line, h3 title, 'Read Article' pill.

editorial.blog-grid.description: 'Previous Articles' heading and a 3-column grid of 290×210 image cards with titles clamped to 3 lines; filtered and empty states.

editorial.blog-sidebar.description: Sticky sidebar (40 from top): fuzzy search, newsletter signup with simulated submit, category pills driving ?category=.

editorial.post-header.description: Post opening: breadcrumb (desktop), 680-wide hero image, date and author line, h1 and category pills.

editorial.post-body.description: Rich-text article body (p, h2 at body size, arrow-marker lists, blockquote bar, images, sup/sub); may embed the gated download form.

editorial.post-share.description: Sticky share column (120 from top): four 36px circle buttons with tooltips; X/LinkedIn/Facebook are non-navigating, Copy Link copies the URL; a row under the article on mobile.

editorial.post-related.description: Two related-article cards, or 'Recent Articles' when a post has none.

hero.info.description: Clone-only info hero: small pill, h2 headline with line reveal and a short intro.

content.info-cards.description: Clone-only numbered bordered card grid under a section title.

content.not-found.description: Light rounded panel with the small pill, a 4-line heading and a 'Take You Back Home' button.

templates.name: Solution detail: service page with stats
Info page (clone-only)
templates.origin: clone-only: replaces outbound Docs and Careers links
